method: fresh pinned source inspection; no compiled native execution
conclusions: Protected helper appends to the supplied vector without clearing it.
Default bValidate is true in the header declaration.
If mpParent is null no element is appended.
With a parent the same bValidate is recursively forwarded, then GetNumber(bValidate) is appended.
GetNumber(false) returns mnNumber without parent Validate; public GetNumberVector uses the default true.
limits: This source-contract inspection and local actual-owner tests do not certify new compiled native lifetime or owner parity.
